hooks.command: diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/ontology/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ontology/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ontology" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/ontology/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ontology/" && cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ontology" && npm install --omit=dev --silent) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ontology/package.json"
